name: @ahpd/agent-claude
description: Claude Code as an Agent Host Protocol backend: a plugin for the ahpd daemon and an Agent for @ahpd/sdk
author: Luiz Fernando Softov <lfs@softov.dev>

ahpd.title: Agent Claude
ahpd.description: Claude Code as an agent backend, one record per configuration.

paths.description: The directories it works in; the first is where a session goes when a client names none. Defaults to the host's.

computerExecutable.description: Where the CLI is inside a machine. claude on the image's PATH by default.

computerCli.description: Where the CLI a machine runs comes from: part, the claude part this host builds, by default; host mounts this host's own installed CLI.

computerCliFallback.description: With computerCli part, what a machine gets when the claude part cannot be built: refuse, by default, refuses the Claude session naming the part; host mounts this host's own CLI instead and logs it.

computerConfigDir.description: The configuration directory the CLI reads inside a machine. /ahpd/<id> by default, /ahpd/claude for the built-in; false leaves the image's own.

handshakeTimeoutMs.description: How long the CLI has to answer its handshake, the bound the SDK's startup is handed, past which the CLI did not start. Default 120000, and a slower machine raises it.
